summary: Full frontend validation of PHASE 4 (Capital Strategy). Executed 3 comprehensive Playwright runs against /capital-strategy on the public preview URL covering all 15 sections, interactive editors (allocation, revenue, opex, cash flow), scenario switchers, edge cases, localStorage persistence, homepage/executive-summary CTA regressions, and route regression checks. 100% of validation checks passed with 0 console errors on every route.
critical_code_review_comments: CapitalStrategyPage.jsx is 1593 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting each numbered section (Hero, Context, CapitalFlow, ThreeScenarios, UseOfCapital, Projection, RevenueModel, OpexModel, CashFlowModel, FinancialScenarios, KpiSection, Feasibility, Milestones, Readiness, Disclaimer) into individual files under /pages/capital-strategy/sections/, and factor out shared primitives (InvestorCenterNav, PendingChip, DataTag, EditableAmount, ComputedTile, FadeIn, useStoredState) into /components/finance/. This will improve readability, reduce reload cost, and enable independent unit testing.

InvestorCenterNav uses window.location.pathname for the active state which is evaluated once at render time; consider useLocation() from react-router-dom to react to route changes without full remounts (currently only re-evaluates because the nav is remounted per page — works, but fragile).

useStoredState relies on JSON.stringify(state) inside a useEffect. For very large or frequently changing state (e.g., all opex_amounts on every keystroke) this triggers a write per key press. Not a bug, but consider debouncing (e.g., 250ms) for smoother behaviour.

The InvestorCenterNav 'external Punto Cero Legal' link uses rel='noreferrer' but omits 'noopener'. Prefer rel='noopener noreferrer' for target=_blank links to avoid the reverse-tabnabbing vector (minor security best practice).

The dot-navigation is hidden below 1100px viewport (per requirements) but there is no fallback in-page anchor menu on tablet/mobile — sections become reachable only by scrolling. Consider a compact bottom sheet or hamburger for medium viewports.

runway logic in CashFlowModel: `const e = parseFloat(ending); const b = parseFloat(expenses); if (!e || !b || b === 0) return null;` — passing `ending` (which is a number, not a string) through parseFloat is fine but redundant. If ending happens to be 0, runway silently returns Pendiente rather than 0. Consider explicit null-check vs falsy check to distinguish 0 balance from missing input.
test_credentials: Not required for this iteration (no auth flow tested). Admin creds available in /app/memory/test_credentials.md if needed.
seed_data_creation: None. localStorage.clear() was called before each Playwright run to avoid contamination.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PHASE 4 Capital Strategy is fully validated end-to-end on the frontend. All 22 review items from the request passed. If future changes are made, the same three Playwright scripts used in this iteration cover: (1) nav + section anchors + dots; (2) scenario switcher + allocation editor + projection + revenue + opex; (3) cash flow + fin scenarios + KPIs + feasibility + milestones + readiness + disclaimer + persistence + CTAs + route regression. Backend regression not re-executed — the request explicitly said 'frontend only (skip backend)'. Prior backend regression from iteration_3 (59/59) still stands since no backend files were modified in Phase 4.
